records.claim: Some men who took verapamil had problems like getting or keeping an erection and lower interest in sex (low sex drive) which may affect male fertility (ability to get a woman pregnant). These problems went away after they stopped taking the medication. Other men who took verapamil did not have these issues. In general, exposures that fathers or sperm donors have are unlikely to increase the risks to a pregnancy. For more information, please see the MotherToBaby fact sheet Paternal Exposures at https://mothertobaby.org/fact-sheets/paternal-exposures-pregnancy/.
records.source_section: If a man takes verapamil, could it affect his fertility or increase the chance of birth defects?
